title: Exact colimit-preserving abelian evaluation on affine weakly contractible objects
statement: Let X be a scheme and W an affine object of its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose evaluation at W sends epimorphisms of set-valued sheaves to surjections. The functor from abelian sheaves to abelian groups taking sections at W preserves homology and all colimits of the permitted size [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Import and apply the existing affine finite covering refinement theorem, now public in its original module. No copy of its statement or proof is retained here.

For a coproduct of abelian sheaves, sheafification gives locally finite-support representatives. The finite covering refinement bounds their supports by one finite set. Sections therefore factor through a finite subcoproduct. Projection to summands proves injectivity of the sectionwise coproduct comparison.

For an epimorphism of abelian sheaves, forgetting to sets is locally surjective and therefore epi. Weak contractibility gives surjectivity on sections. Evaluation already preserves finite limits, so it is exact. Exactness and coproduct preservation imply preservation of all colimits.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_weaklyContractible_abelian_evaluation_colimits
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) [IsAffine W.left]
    (hW : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op W))) :
    let ev := (sheafSections (topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op W)
    ev.PreservesHomology ∧ PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} ev
